title: Saltzer and Schroeder's 1975 Principles of Protection
explainer: Many controls that modern security and compliance frameworks mandate - least privilege, defense in depth, fail-safe defaults, separation of duties - were first articulated systematically by Jerome Saltzer and Michael Schroeder in their 1975 paper on protecting information in computer systems. Contemporary compliance regimes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are largely later codifications of design principles laid out decades before cloud computing existed. This shows today's audit checklists implement much older engineering principles rather than arbitrary bureaucracy.
